# xqplayer

Browser-only HTML5 video player for `mp4` / `m3u8` (HLS) / `flv`, shipped as UMD + ESM + a Vue 2/3 plugin.
Zero runtime dependencies: `hls.js`, `flv.js` and `xqshare` are optional globals detected at runtime.

## Install

```sh
npm i xqplayer
```

## Imports

```js
import XQVideoPlayer from 'xqplayer';                          // default export = constructor
import { XQVideoPlayer as Ctor, VERSION, useShare } from 'xqplayer';
import 'xqplayer/css/xqplayer.css';                            // required for the default skin

import xqVideo from 'xqplayer/vue';                            // Vue 2/3 plugin (SFC, see Constraints)
```

UMD: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/xqplayer/lib/js/xqplayer.min.js">` exposes `window.XQVideoPlayer`.

## Exported API

- `XQVideoPlayer(options: XQPlayerOptions)` — the player. Constructor works with or without `new`.
- `VERSION: string` — package version, same value as `XQVideoPlayer.version`.
- `useShare(ctor: XQShareCtor | null): XQShareCtor | null` — register an `xqshare` constructor once; also
  available as static `XQVideoPlayer.useShare(ctor)`.
- `XQVideoPlayer.isSupportedMode(mode: string): boolean` — `true` for `mp4` / `m3u8` / `flv`.
- `xqVideo` (default of `xqplayer/vue`) — Vue plugin with `install()`; `componentName` is `xqVideo`.
- Types (see `types/index.d.ts`): `XQPlayerOptions`, `XQPlayerState`, `XQBarrageInput`, `XQBarrage`,
  `XQShareCtor`, `XQShareInstance`.

## Key Options

- `el` — **required**. CSS selector or `HTMLElement`. Missing/unmatched target throws.
- `url` — **required**. Video source URL.
- `mode` — `'mp4' | 'm3u8' | 'flv'`, default `'mp4'`. **Not inferred from the URL**: set it explicitly
  for HLS/FLV or the file is fed to the native `<video>` element as mp4.
- `poster` — default `''`. Optional cover image.
- `barrages` — default `[]`. Bullet-screen items `{ content, name, avatar }`, rendered into the panel as-is.
  `time` is accepted but never used for scheduling.
- `width` — `number | string`, default `1200`. Written as the root width.
- `height` — `number | string`, default `600`. Written as the root height. The control bar drops menus
  below 680px and the bullet-screen input below 520px.
- `title` — default `''`. Share title, falls back to `document.title`.
- `share` — default `null`. Per-instance `xqshare` constructor.

## Instance API

Playback and source:

- `playVideo()` — toggles play/pause (does not force play).
- `setVolume(ratio)` / `setVolumeRatio(ratio)` — `0`–`1`.
- `setSpeed(rate)`, `setProgressRatio(ratio)`, `videoMuted()`.
- `reload()` — reloads the current source from `player.options` (error-retry path).
- `loadVideo({ video, type, url, poster })` — low-level loader; see Constraints.
- `setStatus(text)` — transient hint, auto-hides after ~1s.
- `setLoading(bool)`, `setError(msg)`, `clearError()`.
- `fullScreenOpen()`, `fullScreenCancel()`.

Bullet-screen and share:

- `sendBarrage()` — reads the built-in input, appends the item and re-renders. Returns the item, or `null`
  when the input is empty. Arguments are ignored.
- `showBarrage()` — re-renders `player.video.barrageList`. Assign that array to replace the list.
- `shareVideo()` — opens the share popup, returns the `xqshare` instance or `null`.

Lifecycle and helpers:

- `destroy()` — removes the DOM node, detaches every listener, destroys hls/flv and the share widget.
  Idempotent.
- `secondToTime(seconds)` → `'01:01:01'`.
- `q(name)` / `qa(name)` / `dom(name)` / `domAll(name)` / `gid(id)` — scoped DOM lookup inside this instance.
- `toggleControl()`, `toggleInfo()`, `toggleQualBar()`, `toggleSpeed()`, `toggleSet()`, `toggleVol()`,
  `toggleBarrage()`, `addDraw()`, `hideDraw()`, `syncTimeDom()`, `syncProgressDom()`, `syncPlayState()`.

Readable state snapshot: `instance.video` (see `XQPlayerState`). Note `video.vol` is `0`–`100` while
`setVolume()` takes `0`–`1`.

## Typical Use

```js
import XQVideoPlayer from 'xqplayer';
import 'xqplayer/css/xqplayer.css';

const player = new XQVideoPlayer({
    el: '#myPlayer',
    url: './movie.mp4',
    poster: './poster.jpg',
    mode: 'mp4',
    width: 720,
    height: 405,
    barrages: [{ content: 'hello', name: 'guest' }],
});

player.playVideo();
// SPA teardown before removing the container:
player.destroy();
```

HLS needs `window.Hls` to exist before the instance is created:

```js
import Hls from 'hls.js';
window.Hls = Hls;
new XQVideoPlayer({ el: '#myPlayer', url: './stream.m3u8', mode: 'm3u8' });
```

## Constraints

- Browser only. Constructing without `document` throws `[xqplayer] 需要在浏览器环境中使用`.
  Validation errors are thrown as `Error` with the `[xqplayer] ` prefix.
- Import the stylesheet yourself. Without `xqplayer/css/xqplayer.css` the icon font and control-bar layout
  are unstyled. `xqplayer/css/xqplayer-icon.css` ships the icon font only.
- Optional libraries are probed at runtime, never bundled: `window.Hls` (m3u8), `window.flvjs` (flv),
  `window.XqShare` or `useShare()` / `options.share` (share). A missing one degrades that single feature
  (error state or a "分享组件未加载" toast) instead of throwing.
- `mode` is not sniffed from the file extension — see Key Options.
- `loadVideo()` expects the internal shape `{ video, type, url, poster }`. Passing only `{ url }` does not
  switch the source. To change source reliably, mutate `player.options.url` / `player.options.mode` and call
  `reload()`, or create a new instance.
- Call `destroy()` before removing the container in a SPA; multiple instances on one page are isolated.
- `xqplayer/vue` is a `.vue` SFC: the host build needs `vue-loader` / `@vitejs/plugin-vue` plus a `less`
  compiler (the scoped style block is `lang="less"`), and still imports `xqplayer/css/xqplayer.css`.
- The root entry `xqplayer` is the player itself, not the Vue plugin (changed in 0.1.0).
